1.如下图我们标注受力，在斜面的非惯性系中容易写出:

$$2 m a ^ { ' } = 2 m g \sin \theta - f _ { 1 } - 2 m a \cos \theta \tag{1}$$

$$N _ { 1 } = 2 m g \cos \theta + 2 m a \sin \theta \tag{2}$$

在地面系中斜面的运动:

$$ma = f_{1}\cos\theta - N_{1}\sin\theta + f_{2} \tag{3}$$

$$N _ { 2 } = N _ { 1 } \cos \theta + f _ { 1 } \sin \theta + m g \tag{4}$$

转动定理:

$$f _ { 1 } R = I _ { C } \beta \tag{5}$$

注意到内部的液体是无粘性的:

$$I _ { C } = m R ^ { 2 } \tag{6}$$

我们化简得到:

$$f _ { 1 } = m R \beta \tag{7}$$

![](data/images/2020-v2-5ddd1efb/2020-清北学堂-复赛-第二套-v2-1.png)

一共有四种情况:

I. 纯滚、斜面不动

对应了:

$$a = 0 { , } a ^ { ' } = \beta R \tag{8}$$

这要求:

$$f _ { 1 } \leq N _ { 1 } \mu _ { 1 } , f _ { 2 } \leq N _ { 2 } \mu _ { 2 } \tag{9}$$

得到:

$$a = \frac { 1 } { 3 } g , \beta = \frac { 1 } { 3 R } g \tag{10}$$

$$f _ { 1 } = \frac { 2 } { 3 } m g \sin \theta$$

$$N _ { 1 } = 2 m g \sin \theta$$

$$f_{2} = \frac{4}{3}mg\sin\theta\cos\theta$$

$$N _ { 2 } = \left( 1 + \frac { 2 } { 3 } \sin ^ { 2 } \theta + 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta \right) m g \tag{11}$$

这要求了:

$$\mu_{1} \geq \frac{1}{3}\tan \theta, \mu_{2} \geq \frac{4\sin \theta\cos \theta}{5 + 4\cos^{2}\theta} \tag{12}$$

ⅡI. 纯滚，斜面动

对应了:

$$\begin{aligned}a \geq 0, & a^{'} = \beta R \tag{13} \\f_{1} \leq N_{1} \mu_{1}; & f_{2} = N_{2} \mu_{2} \tag{14}\end{aligned}$$

联立解得:

$$a^{'} = \frac{6(\sin \theta - \mu_{2} \cos \theta)}{5 + 4\sin^{2} \theta - 4\mu_{2} \sin \theta \cos \theta} \tag{15}$$

$$\beta = \frac{1}{R} \frac{6 \left( \sin \theta - \mu_2 \cos \theta \right)}{5 + 4 \sin^2 \theta - 4 \mu_2 \sin \theta \cos \theta} \tag{16}$$

这要求:

$$\mu_{2}<\frac{4\sin\theta\cos\theta}{5+4\cos^{2}\theta} \tag{17}$$

$$\mu_{1} \geq \frac{3(\sin \theta - \mu_{2} \cos \theta)}{5(\cos \theta + \mu_{2} \sin \theta)} \tag{18}$$

Ⅲ. 圆柱体滑动，斜面不动

$$\begin{aligned}a = 0 , & a^{'} > \beta R \tag{19} \\f_{1} = \mu_{1} \boldsymbol{N}_{1} ; & f_{2} \leq \mu_{2} \boldsymbol{N}_{2} \tag{20}\end{aligned}$$

解得:

$$a^{'} = g(\sin \theta - \mu_{1} \cos \theta) \tag{21}$$

$$\beta = \frac { 1 } { R } 2 \mu _ { 1 } g \sin \theta \tag{22}$$

这要求:

$$\mu _ { 1 } < \frac { 1 } { 3 } \tan \theta \tag{23} \quad \mu _ { 2 } \geq \frac { 2 ( \sin \theta - \mu _ { 1 } \cos \theta ) \cos \theta } { 1 + 2 \cos ^ { 2 } \theta + 2 \mu _ { 1 } \sin \theta \cos \theta } \tag{24}$$

IV.圆柱滑动，斜面动

$$\begin{aligned}a > 0, & a^{'} > 0 \tag{25} \\f_{1} = \mu_{1} \boldsymbol{N}_{1} ; & f_{2} = \mu_{2} \boldsymbol{N}_{2} \tag{26}\end{aligned}$$

带入得到:

$$\begin{aligned}a^{'} = g \left[ \sin \theta + \frac{2 \cos^2 \theta}{\sin \theta} + \frac{1}{2 \sin \theta} \cdot \frac{(\mu_1 \sin \theta + 2 \cos \theta)(\mu_2 \sin \theta + 2 \cos \theta)}{1 + \sin^2 \theta - (\mu_1 + \mu_2) \sin \theta \cos \theta - \mu_1 \mu_2 \sin^2 \theta} \right] \tag{27} \\\beta = \frac{\mu_1 g}{R} \cdot \frac{\mu_2 \sin \theta + 2 \cos \theta}{1 + \sin^2 \theta - (\mu_1 + \mu_2) \sin \theta \cos \theta - \mu_1 \mu_2 \sin^2 \theta} \tag{28}\end{aligned}$$

这要求:

$$\mu_{2} < \frac{2(\sin \theta - \mu_{1} \cos \theta) \cos \theta}{1 + 2 \cos^{2} \theta + 2 \mu_{1} \sin \theta \cos \theta} \tag{29}, \quad \mu_{1} < \frac{3(\sin \theta - \mu_{2} \cos \theta)}{5(\cos \theta + \mu_{2} \sin \theta)} \tag{30}$$

2.临界值分别为:

$$I { : } \mu _ { 1 } \geq { \frac { \sqrt { 3 } } { 9 } } { , } \mu _ { 2 } \geq { \frac { \sqrt { 3 } } { 8 } } \tag{31}$$

$$\mu_{2} < \frac{\sqrt{3}}{8}, \mu_{1} \geq \frac{3\left( 1 - \sqrt{3}\mu_{2} \right)}{5\left( \sqrt{3} + \mu_{2} \right)} \tag{32}$$

$$\mu _ { 1 } < \frac { \sqrt { 3 } } { 9 } , \mu _ { 2 } \geq \frac { \sqrt { 3 } - 3 \mu _ { 1 } } { 5 + \sqrt { 3 } \mu _ { 1 } } \tag{33}$$

$$I V : \mu _ { 1 } < \frac { 3 \left( 1 - \sqrt { 3 \mu _ { 2 } } \right) } { 5 \left( \sqrt { 3 } + \mu _ { 2 } \right) } , \mu _ { 2 } < \frac { \sqrt { 3 } - 3 \mu _ { 1 } } { 5 + \sqrt { 3 } \mu _ { 1 } } \tag{34}$$

score.note: 关键在建立椭圆轨道几何与地球相交条件求射程，及径向速度积分求时间；需熟练运用开普勒定律、能量守恒及复杂积分技巧，计算量极大且易错。

questions.content:
二、

由万有引力定律:

$$F = \frac{GMm}{r^{2}} = \frac{R^{2}}{r^{2}}mg \tag{1}$$

所以任意位置的引力势能为:

$$V = - \frac{R^{2}}{r} g m \tag{2}$$

洲际导弹的能量为:

$$E = \frac{1}{2} m u^{2} - m g R = - \frac{G M m}{2 a} \tag{3}$$

得到轨道的半长轴长度为:

$$a = \frac{R}{2 - \varepsilon} \tag{4}$$

对于半短轴的位置:

$$\frac{1}{2} m v_{2}^{2} - \frac{G M m}{a} = - \frac{G M m}{2 a} \tag{5}$$

我们可以解得:

$$v_{2} = \sqrt{g R (2 - \varepsilon)} \tag{6}$$

由开普勒第二定律:

$$v_{2}b = uR\cos\theta \tag{7}$$

得到:

$$b = \frac{uR\cos\theta}{\sqrt{gR(2 - \varepsilon)}} = R\cos\theta\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon}{2 - \epsilon}} \tag{8}$$

椭圆方程:

$$\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} + \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1 \tag{9}$$

和地球相交的条件:

$$x^{2} + y^{2} = R^{2} \tag{10}$$

联立可以解得（我们考虑第一第四象限的解）:

$$L = 2 R \arctan \sqrt{- \frac{- 2 + \frac{1}{(2 - \epsilon)^{2}} + (2 - \epsilon)^{2}}{- 2 + \cos^{2} \theta \frac{\epsilon}{2 - \epsilon} + \frac{1}{\cos^{2} \theta} \frac{2 - \epsilon}{\epsilon}}} \tag{11}$$

讨论:

若 $\epsilon < 1, \theta = 0$，对应射程为:

$$2 R \arctan \sqrt{\frac{- 2 + \cfrac{1}{(2 - \epsilon)^{2}} + (2 - \epsilon)^{2}}{- 2 + \cfrac{\epsilon}{2 - \epsilon} + \cfrac{2 - \epsilon}{\epsilon}}} \tag{12}$$

若 $2 > \epsilon > 1, \theta = \arccos \sqrt{\frac{2 - \epsilon}{\epsilon}}$，对应射程为:

$$\pi R \tag{13}$$

(事实上，可以达到更大的角度，对应的象限不同，但是极限射程也就是πR了) 2.对于任意位置，其径向速度的求解:

$$\frac{1}{2} m v_{r}^{2} + \frac{1}{2} m \left( \frac{u R \cos \theta}{r} \right)^{2} - \frac{m g R^{2}}{r} = \left( \frac{\epsilon}{2} - 1 \right) m g R \tag{14}$$

解得:

$$v_{r}=\frac{dr}{dt}=\sqrt{gR}\cdot\sqrt{\frac{2R}{r}+\left(\frac{\epsilon}{2}-1\right)-\frac{\epsilon R^{2}}{r^{2}}\cos^{2}\theta} \tag{15}$$

整理得:

$$\begin{aligned} T &= 2 \int_{R}^{\sqrt{a^{2} - b^{2}}} \frac{dr}{\sqrt{gR} \cdot \sqrt{\cfrac{2R}{r} + \left( \cfrac{\epsilon}{2} - 1 \right) - \cfrac{\epsilon R^{2}}{r^{2}} \cos^{2} \theta}}\\ &= 2 \int_{R}^{\sqrt{a^{2} - b^{2}}} \frac{rdr}{\sqrt{gR} \cdot \sqrt{2Rr + \left( \cfrac{\epsilon}{2} - 1 \right) r^{2} - \epsilon R^{2} \cos^{2} \theta}} \end{aligned} \tag{16}$$

代入积分公式，我们得到:

$$T = \frac{2}{\sqrt{gR}} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{\left( 1 + \frac{\epsilon}{2} - \epsilon \cos^2 \theta \right) R^2}}{1 - \frac{\epsilon}{2}} - \frac{R}{\left( 1 - \frac{\epsilon}{2} \right)^2} \left( \arcsin \frac{(\epsilon - 2) \sqrt{a^2 - b^2} + 2R}{\sqrt{\Delta}} - \arcsin \frac{\epsilon R}{\sqrt{\Delta}} \right) \right] \tag{17}$$

这里:

$$\Delta = 4 R^{2} - 4 \left( \frac{\epsilon}{2} - 1 \right) \epsilon R^{2} \cos^{2} \theta = 4 R^{2} \left[ 1 - \epsilon \left( \frac{\epsilon}{2} - 1 \right) \cos^{2} \theta \right] \tag{18}$$

三、取无穷远为电势零点，则对于电荷元而言，其电势为:

$$\varphi = \int _ { r } ^ { \infty } \frac { 1 } { 4 \pi \epsilon _ { 0 } } \frac { q } { r ^ { 2 + \delta } } d r = \frac { q } { 4 \pi \epsilon _ { 0 } ( 1 + \delta ) } \frac { 1 } { r ^ { 1 + \delta } } \tag{1}$$

考察球面的电势的作用，对于球面上张角为θ的环带而言，电势的贡献为:

$$d \varphi = \frac{1}{4 \pi \epsilon_{0}} \frac{\sigma \cdot 2 \pi R \sin \theta R d \theta}{(1 + \delta) r^{'(1+\delta)}} \tag{2}$$

关于θ进行积分:

$$\begin{array} { l } { \displaystyle \varphi = \frac { \sigma R ^ { 2 } } { 2 \epsilon _ { 0 } ( 1 + \delta ) } { \int } _ { 0 } ^ { \pi } \frac { \sin \theta   d \theta } { ( R ^ { 2 } + r ^ { 2 } - 2 R r \cos \theta ) ^ { \frac { 1 + \delta } { 2 } } } } \\ { \displaystyle = \frac { \sigma R } { 2 \epsilon _ { 0 } ( 1 - \delta ^ { 2 } ) r } \big [ ( R + r ) ^ { 1 - \delta } - | R - r | ^ { 1 - \delta } \big ] \tag{3} } \end{array}$$

对于球内的点:

$$\varphi = \frac { \sigma R } { 2 \epsilon _ { 0 } ( 1 - \delta ^ { 2 } ) r } \big [ ( R + r ) ^ { 1 - \delta } - ( R - r ) ^ { 1 - \delta } \big ] \tag{4}$$

对于球外的点:

$$\varphi = \frac { \sigma R } { 2 \epsilon _ { 0 } ( 1 - \delta ^ { 2 } ) r } \big [ ( R + r ) ^ { 1 - \delta } - ( -   R + r ) ^ { 1 - \delta } \big ] \tag{5}$$

2.以下小量近似公式成立:

$$\begin{aligned}(R + r)^{1 - \delta} &= (R + r) - \delta(R + r)\ln\left( R + r \right) \tag{6} \\(R - r)^{1 - \delta} &= |R - r| - \delta|R - r|\ln\left| R - r \right| \tag{7} \\& \quad 1 - \delta^{2} = 1 \tag{8}\end{aligned}$$

所以电势为:

$$\begin{aligned}\varphi &= \frac{\sigma R}{2\epsilon_{0}r}[2r + \delta[(R - r)\ln\left(R - r\right) - (R + r)\ln\left(R + r\right)]], r < R \\=& \frac{\sigma R}{2\epsilon_{0}r}[2R + \delta[(r - R)\ln\left(r - R\right) - (R + r)\ln\left(R + r\right)]], r > R \\=& \frac{\sigma}{2\epsilon_{0}}[2R - \delta \cdot 2R\ln 2R], r = R  种  \\ 对于两球壳传系 , &  电荷密度分别为  \sigma_{a}, \sigma_{b}(\sigma_{b} \ll \sigma_{a}) \\&\varphi_{a} = \frac{\sigma_{a}}{2\epsilon_{0}}[2a - \delta2a\ln 2a] + \frac{\delta\sigma_{b}}{2\epsilon_{0}a}\{2b + \delta[(a - b)\ln\left(a - b\right) - (a + b)\ln\left(a + b\right)]\} \tag{10} \\&= \frac{\sigma_{a}a}{\epsilon_{0}} - \frac{\delta\sigma_{a}a}{\epsilon_{0}}\ln 2a + \frac{\sigma_{b}b^{2}}{\epsilon_{0}a}\tag{11} \\\varphi_{b} &= \frac{\sigma_{b}}{2\epsilon_{0}}[2b - \delta2b\ln 2b] + \frac{a\sigma_{a}}{2\epsilon_{0}b}\{2b + \delta[(a - b)\ln\left(a - b\right) - (a + b)\ln\left(a + b\right)]\} \tag{12}\end{aligned}$$

$$= \frac { \sigma _ { b } b } { \epsilon _ { 0 } }   +   \frac { \sigma _ { a } a } { \epsilon _ { 0 } }   +   \delta \frac { \sigma _ { a } a } { 2 \epsilon _ { 0 } b } [ ( a - b ) \ln { ( a - b ) } - ( a + b ) \ln { ( a + b ) } ] \tag{13}$$

令:

$$\varphi _ { a } = \varphi _ { b } = U \tag{14}$$

得到:

$$\frac { b \sigma _ { b } } { \epsilon _ { 0 } } \Big ( 1 - \frac { b } { a } \Big ) = -   \delta \Big \{ \frac { a \sigma _ { a } } { \epsilon _ { 0 } } \ln 2 a + \frac { a \sigma _ { a } } { 2 \epsilon _ { 0 } b } \big [ ( a - b ) \ln ( a - b ) - ( a + b ) \ln ( a + b ) \big ] \Big \}   \tag{15}$$

并且:

$$\frac { b \sigma _ { b } } { \epsilon _ { 0 } } \Bigl ( 1 - \frac { b } { a } \Bigr ) \leq u \tag{16}$$

$$\frac { a \sigma _ { a } } { \epsilon _ { 0 } }   \approx   U \tag{17}$$

解得:

$$\delta \leq \frac{2u}{U\left( \ln \frac{a^{2} - b^{2}}{4a^{2}} + \frac{a}{b}\ln \frac{a + b}{a - b} \right)} \tag{18}$$

questions.content:
四、

1.考虑傅里叶热传导定律:

$$J_Q = -\kappa_2 \frac{dT}{dr} \tag{1}$$

由于处于稳态，所以冰层的每个壳层的热量均为 $P$;

$$Q = P = J_Q S = -4\pi r^2 \kappa_2 \frac{dT}{dr} \tag{2}$$

我们积分:

$$\int_{R_1}^{R_2} Q \frac{dr}{r^2} = Q\left(\frac{1}{R_1}-\frac{1}{R_2}\right) = 4\pi\kappa_2(T_1-T_2) \tag{3}$$

冰层外表面的辐射本领为:

$$\sigma T_2^4 (1-r) \times 4\pi R_2^2 = P \tag{4}$$

解得:

$$T_2 = \left(\frac{P}{4\pi\sigma(1-r)R_2^2}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} \tag{5}$$

所以冰层的内表面的温度为:

$$T_1 = \left(\frac{P}{4\pi\sigma(1-r)R_2^2}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} + \frac{(R_2-R_1)P}{4\pi\kappa R_1 R_2} \tag{6}$$

对于冰层内任意位置 $r$，其温度为:

$$T_r = \left(\frac{P}{4\pi\sigma(1-r)R_2^2}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} + \frac{(R_2-r)P}{4\pi\kappa r R_2} \tag{7}$$

现在考虑地幔层和核心区:

其壳层的散热平衡需要修正为:

$$Q = P\frac{r^3}{R^3} = -4\pi r^2 \kappa_1 \frac{dT}{dr} \tag{8}$$

所以:

$$\frac{Pr}{R^3}dr = -4\pi\kappa_1 dT \tag{9}$$

积分可得:

$$\frac{P}{2R^3}(R^2-r^2) = -4\pi\kappa_1(T_1-T_r) \tag{10}$$

所以:

$$T_r = \frac{P}{8\pi\kappa_1 R^3}(R^2-r^2) + \left(\frac{P}{4\pi\sigma(1-r)R_2^2}\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} + \frac{(R_2-R_1)P}{4\pi\kappa R_1 R_2} \tag{11}$$

2.辐射的热平衡，其外表面的能量流入为:

$$Q = (1-r)\frac{\sigma T_0^4 4\pi R_s^2}{4\pi S^2}\cdot \pi R_2^2 \tag{12}$$

所以热平衡要求:

$$(1-r)\frac{\sigma T_0^4 4\pi R_s^2}{4\pi S^2}\cdot \pi R_2^2 + P = \sigma T_2^4 (1-r)\times 4\pi R_2^2 \tag{13}$$

解得:

$$T_2 = \left(\frac{P}{4\pi\sigma(1-r)R_2^2} + \frac{R_S^2}{4S^2}T_0^4\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} \tag{14}$$

其余只是边界条件改变了:

对冰层

$$T_r = \left(\frac{P}{4\pi\sigma(1-r)R_2^2} + \frac{R_S^2}{4S^2}T_0^4\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} + \frac{(R_2-r)P}{4\pi\kappa r R_2} \tag{15}$$

对内层:

$$T_r = \frac{P}{8\pi\kappa_1 R^3}(R^2-r^2) + \left(\frac{P}{4\pi\sigma(1-r)R_2^2} + \frac{R_S^2}{4S^2}T_0^4\right)^{\frac{1}{4}} + \frac{(R_2-R_1)P}{4\pi\kappa R_1 R_2} \tag{16}$$

questions.content:
五、

1. 引入余弦分布电荷:

$$\sigma_{\theta} = \sigma_{0}\cos\theta \tag{1}$$

则电偶极矩为:

$$|\vec{p}| = \frac{4\pi a^{3}}{3}\sigma_{0} \tag{2}$$

内部的电场为:

$$E_{i} = E_{0} - \frac{\sigma_{0}}{3\epsilon_{0}} \tag{3}$$

外部电场为（近邻）:

$$E_{o} = \frac{2\vec{p}}{4\pi\epsilon_{0}a^{3}} + E_{0} = \frac{2\sigma_{0}}{3\epsilon_{0}} + E_{0} \tag{4}$$

电位移矢量的连续性:

$$\left(\frac{2\sigma_{0}}{3\varepsilon_{0}} + E_{0}\right)\varepsilon_{0} = \varepsilon_{0}\varepsilon_{r}\left(E_{0} - \frac{\sigma_{0}}{3\varepsilon_{0}}\right) \tag{5}$$

解得:

$$\sigma_{\theta} = \frac{3(\epsilon_{r} - 1)}{2 + \epsilon_{r}}\epsilon_{0}E_{0}\cos\theta \tag{6}$$

所以极化率为:

$$\alpha = \frac{4\pi a^{3}}{3}\frac{3(\epsilon_{r} - 1)}{2 + \epsilon_{r}}\epsilon_{0} = 4\pi a^{3}\frac{\epsilon_{r} - 1}{2 + \epsilon_{r}}\epsilon_{0} \tag{7}$$

代入数据:

$$\alpha = 2.225 \times 10^{-34} C^{2}S^{2}kg^{-1} \tag{8}$$

2. 小球的重力为:

$$F_{G} = \frac{4}{3}\pi a^{3}\rho_{1}g \tag{9}$$

小球的浮力为:

$$F_{f} = \frac{4}{3}\pi a^{3}\rho_{2}g \tag{10}$$

代入光强中的参量，我们得到光强的完整表达式为:

$$I(r,z) = I_{0}\frac{1}{1 + \displaystyle\frac{\lambda^{2}z^{2}}{\pi^{2}w_{0}^{4}}} e^{-\frac{2r^{2}}{w_{0}^{2}\left(1 + \displaystyle\frac{\lambda^{2}z^{2}}{\pi^{2}w_{0}^{4}}\right)}} \tag{11}$$

所以光强的梯度为:

$$\frac{dI(r,z)}{dz}\bigg|_{r=0} = -I_{0}\frac{\displaystyle\frac{2\lambda^{2}z}{\pi^{2}w_{0}^{4}}}{\displaystyle\left(1 + \frac{\lambda^{2}z^{2}}{\pi^{2}w_{0}^{4}}\right)^{2}} \tag{12}$$

questions.content:
六、
1. 由折射定律：
$$n_1 \sin \theta_1 = n_2 \sin \theta_2 = \ldots = n \sin \theta = \ldots \tag{1}$$
以及：
$$\sin \theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + y'^2}} \tag{2}$$
所以：
$$y'^2 = \frac{n^2}{n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1} - 1 \tag{3}$$
由于 $y' < 0$，取负的开方值：
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{dy}{dx} &= - \sqrt{\frac{n^2}{n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1} - 1} \\ &= - \frac{1}{n_1 \sin \theta_1} \left[ n_0^2 + n_p^2 (1 - e^{-\alpha y}) - n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1 \right]^{\frac{1}{2}} \\ &= - \frac{n_p e^{-\frac{\alpha}{2} y}}{n_1 \sin \theta_1} \left[ -1 + \frac{n_0^2 + n_p^2 - n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1}{n_p^2 e^{-\alpha y}} \right]^{\frac{1}{2}} \tag{4}\end{aligned}$$
进行换元：
$$\phi = \left( \frac{n_0^2 + n_p^2 - n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1}{n_p^2 e^{-\alpha y}} \right)^{\frac{1}{2}} = k e^{\frac{\alpha}{2} y} \tag{5}$$
则方程变为：
$$\frac{dy}{dx} = - \frac{n_p e^{-\frac{\alpha}{2} y}}{n_1 \sin \theta_1} (\phi^2 - 1)^{\frac{1}{2}} \tag{6}$$
注意到：
$$d\phi = \frac{k \alpha}{2} e^{\frac{\alpha}{2} y} dy \tag{7}$$
所以：
$$dx = - \frac{2}{k \alpha} \frac{n_1}{n_p} \sin \theta_1 \frac{d\phi}{(\phi^2 - 1)^{\frac{1}{2}}} \tag{8}$$
积分得到：
$$x = - \frac{2}{k \alpha} \frac{n_1}{n_p} \sin \theta_1 \arccos \phi + C \tag{9}$$
积分常数通过初值条件确定：
$$C = \frac{2 n_1 \sin \theta_1}{k \alpha n_p} \arccos \left( k e^{\frac{\alpha}{2} H} \right) \tag{10}$$
所以轨迹为：
$$y = \frac{2}{\alpha} \ln \left\{ \frac{\cosh \left[ - \frac{k \alpha n_p}{2 n_1 \sin \theta_1} (x - C) \right]}{k} \right\} \tag{11}$$
2. 同理，可以写出：
$$\frac{dy}{dx} = \pm \sqrt{\frac{n^2}{n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1} - 1} \tag{12}$$
带入得到：
$$\frac{dy}{dx} = \pm \frac{n_p e^{-\frac{\alpha}{2} y}}{n_1 \sin \theta_1} \left[ 1 - \frac{n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1 - n_0^2}{n_p^2} e^{\alpha y} \right]^{\frac{1}{2}} \tag{13}$$
令：
$$k = \sqrt{\frac{n_1^2 \sin^2 \theta_1 - n_0^2}{n_p^2}}, \quad \phi = k e^{\frac{\alpha}{2} y} \tag{14}$$
则：
$$dx = \pm \frac{2 n_1 \sin \theta_1}{k \alpha n_p} \frac{d\phi}{\sqrt{1 - \phi^2}} \tag{15}$$
解得：
$$y = \frac{2}{\alpha} \ln \left\{ \frac{1}{k} \sin \left[ \pm \frac{k \alpha n_p}{2 n_1 \sin \theta_1} (x - C) \right] \right\} \tag{16}$$
其中积分常数为：
$$C = \mp \frac{2 n_1 \sin \theta_1}{k \alpha n_p} \arcsin \left( k e^{\frac{\alpha}{2} H} \right) \tag{17}$$
